blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur, Philippines — Police arrested a 43-year-old village councilor tagged as a high-value target during a pre-dawn raid in Labangan town, Zamboanga del Sur, on Friday, Nov. 20. Apart from the arrest, authorities also seized suspected crystal meth and an improvised firearm. Capt. Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson of the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office (ZSPPO), said operatives of the Labangan Municipal Police Station served search warrants against the barangay kagawad around 2 a.m. at Purok Gadungan in Barangay Bulanit.
